description: From Plaza de Santa Maria you face the cathedral's west front, the twin openwork spires climbing either side of the ornate Gothic facade. The pale limestone holds a warm floodlit glow against the overcast night sky, and behind it the great cimborrio crossing tower rises over the crossing. The paved square in front is empty and the city quiet — only the lit stone, the lit plaza lamps and the dark sky above the towers.
